description: Defines classes and interfaces for a time QoS-aware scheduler policy, including traffic history management, rate estimation, and scheduling priorities within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: ue_history_repository
classes.description: Manages historical traffic data for UEs, including average UL/DL rates and grants.

classes.name: rate_estimator
classes.description: Estimates maximum transport block sizes for UEs based on current channel conditions.

classes.name: scheduler_time_qos
classes.description: Implements a time-domain QoS-aware scheduling policy for UEs.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the traffic history repository.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the traffic history repository.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::save_dl_newtx_grants
methods.description: Stores new DL grants allocated to UEs.

methods.name: ue_history_repository::save_ul_newtx_grants
methods.description: Stores new UL grants allocated to UEs.

methods.name: rate_estimator::estimate_max_dl_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum DL transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: rate_estimator::estimate_max_ul_tbs
methods.description: Estimates maximum UL transport block size for a UE.

methods.name: scheduler_time_qos::add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to the scheduler.

methods.name: scheduler_time_qos::rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the scheduler.
